Dialogs used by only one screen live in app-wide blocks instead of that screen's route folder. Fix: Move dialogs used by only one screen into that screen's components/ folder and import from there; keep only AddProjectDialog, used by S06 and S07, in web/app/blocks/.

Failed-load markup is copied on every screen and client status tags are re-implemented instead of reused. Fix: Extract the repeated failed-load alert with retry into one shared component or function and use it on every screen, and render client status with the existing ClientStatusTag.

The change contains dead code: an unused import and exported helpers nothing imports. Fix: Remove the unused Time import and remove unused exports such as followUpState, FollowUpState and isSlotFull from web/app/blocks/Slots/slots.ts.

List screens show their empty message while records are still loading and show no loading state. Fix: Show a loading state while list hooks are loading and show the empty message with its actions only after loading finishes with zero records.

Record screens return NotFound while the record is still loading and show no loading state. Fix: Show a loading state while the get hooks are loading and show NotFound only after loading finishes with no record.
Availability shows no Edit action when nothing is saved so the empty state cannot be filled. Fix: Offer Edit/Done controls when no availability is saved so empty weekly hours can be created.
Cancel-slot confirm does not show the slot's session type and time. Fix: Show the slot's session type name and time in the cancel dialog title or content.
Destructive row icon buttons use danger variant while other row actions use base. Fix: Use the same quiet base ghost icon buttons with tooltips for edit and delete row actions.
No one-line text uses Truncate so long values can wrap or overflow. Fix: Wrap one-line text such as names, cells, breadcrumbs and status lines in Truncate.
issues.at: Tables, cells and status lines across S04-S15

issues.message: The client email shows twice, as the header subtitle and again in Details. Fix: Remove description={record.email} from the PageHeader so the email shows only once, in Details.
When there are no notes Add a note shows twice, above the list and again in the empty state. Fix: Hide the Notes headerAction while the list is empty so Add a note shows only once in the empty state.

When there are no projects Add a project shows twice, above the list and again in the empty state. Fix: Hide the Projects headerAction while the list is empty so Add a project shows only once in the empty state.

When there are no tasks Add a task shows twice, above the list and again in the empty state. Fix: Hide the Tasks headerAction while the project has no tasks so Add a task shows only once in the empty state.

Details repeats the same facts as Session type plus Time plus Slot link, showing the time twice with conflicting values. Fix: Show each fact once in Details: Name, Email, Linked client, and Slot as the single link with session type name and time formatted one way; remove the separate Session type and Time rows.

The same slot shows two different times: title says 10:00 while Details says 15:30. Fix: Render the header title and the Details Session line from the same formatted slot title so both show the identical date and time.

Cancel dialog does not identify which slot is being cancelled. Fix: Include the slot's session type name and date/time in the confirm dialog content, e.g. the formatted slot title, plus the note that every booking on it is cancelled.

The title reads 5 Nov at 10:00 while Details Time reads 5 Nov 2026, 15:30 for the same slot. Fix: Show one formatted slot time in both places, so the title and the Time row read the same, for example Discovery call, 5 Nov at 10:00 and Time 5 Nov at 10:00.

Book another time sits alone after the Details section instead of with the cancelled result. Fix: Put Book another time in the PageHeader actions with the This booking was cancelled result and remove the lone button after the Details section.

TaskStatusTag file is used by only one screen but lives in app-wide components. Fix: Move TaskStatusTag and TaskPriorityTag into web/app/(routes)/(app)/projects/[projectId]/components/ and import them from there, keeping web/app/components/ for pieces used by two or more screens.

Availability time fields use a raw input element instead of the existing Input component. Fix: Replace the raw <input type="time"> inside FormControl with the design-system Input component for From time and To time.

updateAccount keeps email-taken state in a non-persistent Set unlike the store beside it. Fix: Track known emails in the persistent auth store like the sibling operations do instead of a module-level Set, so the email-taken check survives reload.

The dialog shows the gone alternative whenever data is missing, including while the note is still loading. Fix: Show the form while the note is loading and show 'This note is gone.' only when the load has finished without data.

The dialog shows the gone alternative whenever data is missing, including while the task is still loading. Fix: Show the form while the task is loading and show the gone message only when the load has finished without data.

The dialog shows the gone alternative whenever data is missing, including while the session type is still loading. Fix: Show the form while the session type is loading and show the gone message only when the load has finished without data.

The title calls formatSlotTitle with '' when the slot is not yet loaded, which throws on Invalid Date and crashes the view. Fix: Do not call formatSlotTitle/formatSlotTime until slot.data.startAt is present; wait for slot loading or render a fallback title when the slot is still loading.

The two task filters both show only All with no visible label so the user cannot tell status from priority. Fix: Show a visible label for each filter with the search above the task list, such as labeled selects or values reading Status: All and Priority: All.
